payload.title: Implement FTS5 text search
payload.description:
**Files:** `src/store/text.rs` (new), `src/store/query.rs`, `tests/steps/store_steps.rs`.

**Specs turned green:** `07_text_search.feature` — remove its @wip.

**Acceptance:** FTS5 match over the message text projections written at ingest, ranked, returning matched sessions and their matching messages, composable with the filters task. (If any bundled-SQLite target lacked FTS5, the walking skeleton's smoke test would already have failed — do not build a silent LIKE fallback; report on this task instead.)

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
